assessment.reason: C4 exceeds the frozen target in all three suites and C2 improves, while C1 throughput is lower in all three; the conflicting primary outcomes require an owner decision.
assessment.service_state: The healthy E03 plus replay views plus draft-budget candidate remains loaded and idle on all four ranks. Temporary host observers and the task tunnel are stopped. No promotion, rollback, commit or push was performed. A later lifecycle transition needs a new coordinated authorization.
assessment.causal_limit: The one-request budget and policy are unchanged in CPU checks. These noncontemporaneous measurements establish an observed C1 tradeoff, not its cause.
detail_paragraphs: **C4 recovery is repeatable in this series:** 88.783 / 92.596 / 90.572 tok/s, all above the 87.527 target and the baseline’s observed 87.031–88.023 range. The median is **90.572 tok/s (+3.48% versus baseline, +9.13% versus E03 plus replay)**. C2 also improves in every suite: its 62.094 tok/s median is **+8.46% / +3.42%** versus those references.

**C1 is the primary tradeoff:** 39.159 / 38.762 / 38.749 tok/s, all below both reference ranges. Its **38.762 tok/s** median is **−3.82% versus baseline and −2.60% versus the parent**. The one-request budget remains five and CPU checks preserve its original adaptive decisions; this does not establish the cause of the measured decrease. C2/C4 gains do not automatically outweigh the repeated C1 reduction, so the outcome is **decision_required**.

Code decode (−0.29% versus baseline) and prose (−0.50%) have overlapping observed ranges with the baseline. Code TTFT is 12.5 ms higher at the median. Long replay gains are retained: 32K TTFT is **0.881 s**, versus 0.910 s in the parent and 0.930 s in the baseline; 64K is **1.655 s**, versus 1.669 s and 1.849 s. The 64K difference from the parent is within its observed range.

8K replay is less consistent: native per-run throughput is **9,436.190 / 7,757.561 / 9,637.624 tok/s**, with a median **−1.27% versus baseline / −1.82% versus the parent**. The second run’s slower samples remain included. Cold 8K is −2.45% versus the parent but +9.22% versus baseline. No sample, metric block or complete run was excluded.

Client-minus-server summed request duration is **0.622 / 0.643 / 0.630 s** across the respective 54-request suites; TTFT differences are **1.422 / 1.416 / 1.457 s**. Exact API counts match all three suites, and the much larger parent timing anomaly did not recur. These aggregate counters do not identify the cause of individual timing variations.

aggregation: Median of 3 complete native per-run values; initial C4 screen excluded. Baseline uses two frozen native values; parent uses three with its documented C1-only replacement. Ranges and sample standard deviations describe observed dispersion, not confidence intervals.

limitations: Frozen comparisons are not contemporaneous baseline reloads.
The initial C4 screen has a different preceding workload from a complete suite and is excluded from all suite aggregates.
The draft/placeholder mismatch also exists in the baseline; its correction does not establish why the parent lost C4 throughput.
Native output gates and normal token-budget stops are separate from performance integrity.
Host memory minima are sampled and CUDA allocator peaks cover worker lifetime without reset.
